name: Toedscool
description: Toedscool, the Woodear Pokémon. Able to evolve into Toedscruel. A Ground and Grass type.
pokedex_entries: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.
